title: Run a backup restoration and disaster recovery drill
summary: Before relying on a recovery plan and on the company's agreed exercise cadence. A measured recovery result against approved objectives, with failed dependencies assigned and retested.
outcomes: A measured recovery result against approved objectives, with failed dependencies assigned and retested.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before relying on a recovery plan and on the company's agreed exercise cadence.

parts.title: Select the recovery scenario and critical data
parts.guidance: Identify the service, data dependencies, recovery point and outage scenario to test. Confirm the approved recovery objectives and authorized test environment, including keys, identities and external dependencies.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve the exercise safeguards and owners
parts.guidance: The accountable service and security owners approve the test scope, isolation, communication and stop conditions. Protect production and sensitive data and confirm who may authorize destructive or customer-affecting actions.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve the exercise safeguards and owners

parts.title: Restore the selected backup in isolation
parts.guidance: Authorized operators recover the approved backup, dependencies and access using the documented runbook. Record actual times, failures and deviations without overwriting the production system.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the reviewed account operation described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Restore the selected backup in isolation

parts.title: Verify data integrity and business operation
parts.guidance: Check completeness, consistency and the agreed business transactions in the restored environment. Compare actual data loss and recovery time with objectives and distinguish a readable backup from a usable service.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve remediation and a repeat test
parts.guidance: Owners review the evidence, assign fixes and retest failed controls. Update the runbook and recovery assumptions and retain the exercise result and unresolved risks.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve remediation and a repeat test

verify.how: A measured recovery result against approved objectives, with failed dependencies assigned and retested.
